Some of my books are free to read online, in full. These are **living editions**: I update
them as new research appears, and I link the text to the original papers, working papers, and
[datasets](https://github.com/johanfourieza) behind each argument. Looking for a copy to buy
instead? Visit the [Bookshop](bookshop.qmd).
